title: Book a counselling session (Student Wellbeing & Counselling)
summary: Free, confidential individual counselling for full-time and part-time students, in person or online. Not for emergencies: the team replies within 3 working days.
steps: Log in to the Kaplan360 app.
Tap the "Academic" icon in the bottom navigation bar.
Open the "Counselling" tab.
Tap "+ New" (bottom right) and fill in the Counselling Request Form.
Answer all questions and tap "Submit". The counselling team will contact you within 3 working days.
notes: Counsellors do not diagnose or prescribe medication. Confidential, except where there is an imminent threat to life or safety.
contact: Student Wellbeing & Counselling, via the Kaplan360 app

title: Apply for leave when you miss class (Leave of Absence)
summary: Apply for leave in the Kaplan360 app at least 1 working day before class, or within 3 working days after an emergency. Maximum 3 days per application.
steps: Open the Kaplan360 app.
Go to the leave application section.
Choose your leave dates and reason.
Upload supporting documents (e.g. MC, death notice, employer letter, NS letter). If leaving Singapore, also upload your flight itinerary or boarding pass.
Submit. Student Services approves or rejects within 5 working days.
notes: Valid grounds: illness (MC from a Singapore-registered doctor, TCM practitioner, dentist or hospital), compassionate (immediate family, up to 3 working days), accident, National Service, work commitment, legal commitment. NOT accepted: holidays planned after the programme started, oversleeping, misreading the timetable, poor network. Need more than 3 days? Consider deferment instead.
contact: Your programme's Student Services team (see the Student Services contacts entry)

title: How attendance works (QR scanning and minimum rates)
summary: Scan the class QR code twice: within 15 minutes of the start, and again after class ends. Student's Pass holders need 90% monthly attendance; everyone else needs 75%.
steps: Scan the QR code shown in class within 15 minutes of the start (later counts as late).
Scan again after the class ends (missing it counts as leaving early).
If the QR code won't scan, tell your lecturer so they can mark you manually.
Check your real-time attendance rate in the Kaplan360 app.
notes: Online classes: attendance is based on logging in and taking part. Asynchronous lessons: based on accessing materials in the LMS. Student's Pass holders below 90% are reported to ICA; 7 consecutive days absent can lead to Student's Pass cancellation. Student's Pass holders are also required to self-study at school for at least 3 hours daily; if a class is shorter than 3 hours, you must top up the remaining time with self-study.
contact: Your lecturer (for scanning issues) or Student Services

title: Find your classes, timetable and classroom
summary: Your personalised timetable and assigned classrooms are in the Kaplan360 app.
steps: Open the Kaplan360 app and log in.
Open your timetable / study plan.
Tap a class to see its time and assigned classroom.
Check which campus the room is at [Wilkie Edge (WE), Odeon 331 (OD) or Odeon 333 (NB)].
notes: Online classes and materials are on your LMS (see the LMS entry). Don't have Kaplan360 login details yet? See the Kaplan360 login entry.

title: Get access to the Kaplan360 app
summary: Kaplan360 login details are sent to you after your programme officially starts. Kaplan360 lets you check classrooms, notifications, attendance, apply for leave, complete the onboarding checklist and update contact details.
steps: Download Kaplan360 from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Log in with the credentials Kaplan sends you after your programme starts.
Haven't received them, or locked out? Contact your Student Services team.
notes: Access to Kaplan360 and the LMS is suspended if you have outstanding fees (Bad Financial Standing).

title: Access the LMS (study guides, assignments, results)
summary: Study guides, assignment submission, exam rules and final grades are on the eLearn Learning Management System (LMS).
steps:
Go to your LMS portal:
Murdoch students (degree): (https://moodleprod.murdoch.edu.au/my/)
Kaplan students (diploma): (https://elearn.kaplan.com.sg/)
Log in with your student account.
Open your module to find the study guide and assignment submission page.
Submit assignments before the deadline. The submission portal only opens within the stated dates.
notes: Uploading the correct file is your responsibility. Murdoch students' enrolled units also appear in the Murdoch University student portal.

title: Check exam results
summary: Final grades are released on the LMS within 30 calendar days after the exam. Phone and walk-in grade enquiries are not entertained.
steps: Log in to the LMS about 30 days after your exam.
Open your module to view the final grade.
Disagree with a result? See the academic appeal entry. You have 7 working days.
notes: For academic records or certificate verification after graduating, email academicrecords.sg@kaplan.com.
